examShortTricks: Trick 1: μ = Σxi pi; Var = Σxi² pi − μ² — compute three columns (xipi, xi²pi) and subtract; never average the raw x values.
Trick 2: SD = √Var — leave as a surd unless the square is exact; quoting Var when SD is asked loses the mark.
Trick 3: Sanity bounds: μ must lie between min and max xi; Var ≥ 0 — use to catch arithmetic slips.
Trick 4: For linear transforms Y = aX + b: μY = aμX + b, VarY = a²VarX — the shift b does NOT change variance.
